r = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
commits = [l for l in r.stdout.strip().split('\n') if l]
print(f"Commits on base: {len(commits)}")

r2 = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '-x', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider',
     'tests/test_filesize.py', 'tests/test_i18n.py', 'tests/test_lists.py',
     'tests/test_number.py', 'tests/test_time.py'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print(f"Tests pass: {r2.returncode == 0}")

# Try rlm.finish with different parameter names
for param_name in ['summary', 'text', 'message', 'result']:
    try:
        result = await world.call('rlm.finish', **{param_name: "All 3 milestones implemented and committed. m1: tz-aware naturalday, m2: tz-aware naturaldate, m3: empty list guard in natural_list. 684 tests pass."})
        print(f"rlm.finish({param_name!r}): ok={result.get('ok')}, content={str(result.get('content'))[:100]}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"rlm.finish({param_name!r}): ERROR {e}")
